[ASSISTANT_SAID] User can load the T5 model using the code: `const model = await tf.loadGraphModel('path/to/t5/model.json');`.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] User needs to load the tokenizer using the code: `const tokenizer = new Tokenizer();`.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] User needs to tokenize the input text and encode it using the loaded tokenizer with the code: `const tokenizedText = tokenizer.encode(inputText); const inputIds = tf.tensor2d(tokenizedText, [1, tokenizedText.length], 'int32');`.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] User can generate the paraphrased text using the code: `const outputs = await model.executeAsync({...}); const paraphrasedText = tokenizer.decode(outputs[0].dataSync());`.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] User can return the generated paraphrased text to the frontend using the code: `res.json({ paraphrasedText: paraphrasedText });`.
